brand.tagline: Pioneers of kitesurfing with the invention of the first inflatable kites
brand.intro: Takoon has contributed to the rise of a sport in full evolution. Since then, we have pushed the boundaries of sliding sports by developing equipment that is innovative, high-performing, and accessible. Our mission: to allow all riders—whether beginners or advanced—to progress, have fun, and ride with confidence, using reliable, simple, and well-designed gear. No compromises. No middlemen. Just real equipment, made for those who live for their passion.
brand.mission: For over 20 years, Takoon has been designing innovative, high-performance, and accessible sliding sports equipment. Our goal is simple: to enable all riders, both beginners and experienced, to progress, have fun, and ride with confidence.
brand.vision: We believe in free riding, without compromises. A practice that focuses on the essentials: real sensations, functional equipment, and a connected community. That's why we've chosen a direct sales model. Fewer intermediaries, more value. Less talk, more action.
brand.innovation: For us, innovation means improving what truly matters. Rethinking the shape of a kite, refining profiles, and lightening constructions. We select high-performance materials and test every detail to ensure the best possible experience on the water. Every kite, every board, every foil is designed, developed, and fine-tuned by our team in France, with constant attention to performance, reliability, and riding pleasure.
brand.team: Takoon is not just a brand. It's a team of dedicated riders who design, test, and improve every product with precision and passion. We stay close to our community: ambassadors, customers, and practitioners, whose real-world feedback constantly fuels our development.

cruise.tagline: Pleasure and simplicity for beginners and progression
cruise.presentation: Designed to make your first steps in wingfoiling easy and enjoyable, the Cruise is the perfect board for starting out with confidence. Its generous volume and reassuring shape provide outstanding stability, even when stationary, helping you approach your first sessions with ease and peace of mind. Thanks to its effortless take-off, you'll quickly experience the magical feeling of flying on a foil. No need to be an expert — the Cruise makes take-offs simple and intuitive. Landings are just as smooth, making it easier to learn maneuvers without falling every time. But the Cruise doesn't stop there. Versatile and progressive, it will accompany you well beyond your beginnings. It allows for fast progression, helping you perform your first manoeuvers and even catch your first waves in wingfoiling. Its wide and forgiving outline ensures comfort and control in flight, even during touchdowns, for smooth and motivating progress. The Cruise is designed for all riders, whether light or heavier, beginners or those already improving. It combines accessibility, stability, and progression potential, making it an essential reference for learning and advancing in wingfoiling.
cruise.shape: For the shape of our Cruise, we sought the best compromise between ease and glide. Not too long nor too short, its dimensions and volume have been optimized to offer you maximum stability, even when stopped or on your knees. With a less rounded and wider outline, the Cruise provides perfect longitudinal and lateral stability. Its straighter rails also enhance stability without compromising glide. Additionally, to bring the rider closer to the foil, the Cruise features a concave deck. This lowers the rider's center of gravity for better stability and control of the board.
cruise.construction: MCT (Molded Composite Technology). EPS foam core, light and molded according to our design. Core is laminated with a composite of fiberglass layers and epoxy resin, reinforced with a high-quality topsheet protective shield. Topsheet made from extremely reliable durable material widely used in twin-tip industry, skis, and snowboards. One-piece molded construction offers remarkable strength and exceptional dynamics.
cruise.equipment: Carrying Handle (ergonomic, on the bottom — one hand for board+foil, other for wing). EVA Pad (3.5mm multi-piece grooved — grip, comfort, water drainage). Molded carbon US box V3 (33cm/38cm; 6/11cm longer than Futures; pre-preg carbon high-pressure high-temp mold).

slide.tagline: The Slide is a parawing-dedicated board that delivers exceptional glide and high-level performance, while remaining perfectly versatile for wing foil and SUP foil use.
slide.presentation: Designed primarily for Parawing, the Slide is a versatile board that also excels in SUP foil and wing foil. The Slide stands out with a specifically forward-distributed volume. Compared to the Ultra Glide or the Glide Midlength, this forward-oriented distribution has been designed to reduce nose-diving and make pumping phases easier, providing more tolerance and efficiency before takeoff. It combines outstanding stability with optimized glide, making takeoff easier and accelerating progression. An ideal solution for riders looking for a single board that performs efficiently across a wide range of conditions. Its full PVC carbon sandwich construction delivers the perfect balance of strength, stiffness, and light weight. The result: a responsive, precise, and enjoyable board that provides direct sensations whether riding powered-up or cruising. Its shape enables fast and effortless takeoff, with smooth and natural acceleration. Specifically developed for Parawing, the Slide stands out for its excellent speed retention and extended glide. This efficiency also shines in SUP foil and wing foil, whether in freeride, freefly, surf, or during long glide phases. Another key design element is the molded carbon prepreg US box. Longer, stiffer, and featuring dual entry points, it ensures optimal power transfer, precise adjustments, and enhanced durability.
slide.shape: The Slide features an optimized shape designed to maximize lift and minimize drag. Its smooth lines and aerodynamic contours ensure excellent air penetration. Forward-distributed volume reduces nose-diving and makes pumping phases easier.
slide.construction: Full PVC Carbon sandwich. Molded Carbon US Boxes (pre-preg carbon, high pressure & temperature, ultra-stiff, virtually indestructible). Extended carbon boxes with double opening (38cm vs Futures, dual rail system).
slide.equipment: Full deck pad + 3 footstrap inserts. 🔥 New 2026: Premium custom-fit day bag included. XL double-zip opening. Mini nose protector included.
slide.volume_guide: Experienced riders: volume equivalent to body weight. Intermediate: ~+15L above body weight. Beginners: +20 to +25L for greater stability and easier takeoff.

glide.tagline: High-performing and versatile in freeride, wave, and race disciplines.
glide.presentation: The Glide – 2026 Edition retains the shape that made the 2025 version such a success. Its balance, easy takeoff, and versatility remain unchanged, with a hull that is as efficient and intuitive as ever. The Glide now features a one-piece deck pad, providing enhanced comfort and a more consistent feel underfoot. It is also offered in an expanded size range, now available in 6 sizes, from 4'9 (60L) to 5'8 (110L), to cover a wider variety of rider profiles and programs.
glide.construction: Full PVC Carbon sandwich. Molded carbon US boxes with dual openings (38cm, 11cm longer than Futures).
glide.shape: Slim and elongated outline with homogeneous volume distribution centered around the board's center of gravity. Concave and slightly recessed deck. Triple concave hull. V-Tail (smooth water flow, reduces drag, locks rail during pumping). Dual-rocker line (relatively flat central rocker with slight nose scoop, more pronounced lateral rockers as natural channels).

glide-midlength.tagline: The Glide Midlength is a wingfoil board that delivers insane glide and top performance across all riding styles.
glide-midlength.presentation: The Glide Midlength – 2026 Edition retains the shape that made its 2025 launch such a success, praised for its perfect balance and exceptional glide. The deck pad now features a one-piece design for enhanced comfort and optimized feel underfoot. Initially available in 5 sizes, the Glide Midlength 2026 now comes in 11 sizes, from 4'10 (45L) to 7'10 (145L), to suit all rider profiles and programs. Designed to deliver outstanding glide and versatile performance—whatever your style or level—the Glide Midlength is built in full PVC Carbon sandwich construction. Its midlength format strikes the perfect balance between downwind boards and compact shapes: not too long, not too short, but perfectly tuned to maximize enjoyment.
glide-midlength.shape: Refined shape allows early and effortless takeoff with smooth natural acceleration. Excels in freeride, freefly, surf, jump. Midlength format balances downwind boards and compact shapes.
glide-midlength.tail: Straight, clean tail designed to promote fast smooth water release, minimizing drag and boosting acceleration.
glide-midlength.rocker: Progressive rocker line. Flatter rocker through center for natural efficient glide (reduce fatigue, ease planing). Up front, curve becomes progressively more pronounced, preventing nose digging during transitions or landings.
glide-midlength.construction: Full PVC Carbon sandwich. Molded carbon US boxes (38cm, ultra-stiff, virtually indestructible). Extended carbon boxes with dual openings.
glide-midlength.equipment: Full one-piece deck pad + 3 footstrap inserts. EVA pad 3.5mm multi-piece grooved. 🔥 2026: Premium custom-fit day bag included.
glide-midlength.volume_guide: Experienced: body weight equivalent. Intermediate: ~+15L above body weight. Beginners: +20 to +25L.

ultra-glide.tagline: Midlength board: versatile and efficient for light wind conditions.
ultra-glide.presentation: The Ultra Glide – 2026 Edition retains the shape that made the 2025 version such a success, recognized for its light wind efficiency, pure glide, and easy takeoff. The deck pad now features a one-piece design. Initially available in 5 sizes in 2025, the Ultra Glide is now offered in 9 sizes, from 5'8 (60L) to 7'4 (140L). Specifically designed for light wind wing foiling, it also fits perfectly within the downwind SUP and prone trend. Its narrow shape reduces drag and promotes quick takeoffs, even in marginal conditions. Versatile, it remains highly efficient as the wind increases, ensuring control and stability.
ultra-glide.construction: Full PVC Carbon sandwich. Molded carbon US box (stiffer, higher performing, optimal power transfer, direct foil connection). Extended carbon boxes with double opening.
ultra-glide.shape: Specifically designed to maximize lift and reduce drag. Sleek outline and aerodynamic contours ensure excellent air penetration.
ultra-glide.target: Designed for advanced and expert riders, built for those who want to maximize their time on the water and push their limits in light conditions. Expert: +10L above body weight. Advanced: +20L above body weight.

prosurf.tagline: A board tailored for wingfoiling in waves.
prosurf.presentation: The Prosurf 2026 retains the highly acclaimed shape of the previous edition and evolves with a new one-piece deck pad. Now available in 5 sizes, from 4'9 (50L) to 5'2 (70L). Its Full PVC Carbon Sandwich construction guarantees an exceptional balance of strength, stiffness, and light weight. Specifically designed for wing foiling in waves, the Prosurf is the ideal tool for wave-riding enthusiasts seeking pure performance. Inspired by true surf foil boards rather than traditional wing foil shapes, the Prosurf delivers authentic surf sensations. It allows for radical carving, attacking steep waves, exploring offshore bumps, or enjoying long, fluid freefly sessions. Versatile and agile, it also excels in wingless freefly and responds perfectly to pumping. Whether downwinding or surfing, it connects waves and bumps with remarkable ease.
prosurf.shape: The Prosurf shape was imagined from a water droplet, with all internal volumes carved within this outline. This aerodynamic form, combined with the board's slim profile, delivers unmatched and pure glide while flying. The bulb at the front helps balance the volumes, providing smooth displacement glide.
prosurf.tail: Round tail, providing stability and speed generation. A slight release at the beginning of the tail adds more rebound on touchdowns and allows for more radical carving without the risk of catching the water. Thickness around foil boxes optimized to be reduced.
prosurf.rocker: Very progressive rocker line inspired by surf foils. Flat at the rear (feet parallel to foil). Nose scoop relatively pronounced to enhance maneuverability and touchdown tolerance.
prosurf.construction: Full PVC Carbon sandwich. Takoon molded carbon US box (longer, stiffer, dual entry points).
prosurf.target: Designed for intermediate to expert riders seeking greater freedom, control, and performance in committed wave riding, downwind runs, or choppy conditions.

cloud-one.tagline: Cloud One — accessible Parawing for discovery and progression
cloud-one.presentation: The Parawing Cloud One stands out with a robust and optimized profile, delivering reliable performance and excellent upwind ability, even in unstable or gusty wind conditions, while offering smooth and effective depower. It features the same shape and design as the Parawing Cloud, ensuring healthy, stable and confidence-inspiring handling on the water. The main difference lies in the choice of materials. The Cloud One is equipped with a triple ripstop 54 g/m² canopy, while the Parawing Cloud uses lighter, more technical Skytex fabrics. This choice allows the Cloud One to be offered at a more accessible price point, while maintaining very good performance, excellent durability and high tolerance for regular use. As a trade-off, the Cloud One has a slightly less efficient low-end range than the Cloud, whose Skytex canopy provides additional lightness and responsiveness in light wind. Its balanced line lengths—neither too short nor too long—ensure natural handling and easy packing on the water in a single movement. Its full carbon bar, identical to that of the Cloud, is lightweight, ergonomic and precise. It delivers a direct feel and optimal control, enabling smooth riding while reducing fatigue and maximizing rider comfort, regardless of session length. Designed with simplicity and practicality in mind, the Parawing Cloud One also features color-coded bridles for easy detangling, durable materials, and a clear color code distinguishing front, middle and rear lines. This visual differentiation makes relaunch quick and intuitive, while the color matching between the leading edge, trailing edge and associated lines further enhances ease of use, just like on the Cloud. The Parawing Cloud One is offered in three carefully selected sizes, covering the most common and versatile range, whereas the Parawing Cloud is available in five sizes. This deliberately streamlined range provides a clear and simple product offering, making wing selection easier and positioning the Cloud One as an ideal choice for riders looking to start and progress in parawing without unnecessary complexity. To fully unlock the potential of the Cloud One, it is recommended to pair it with a midlength or downwind-style board, offering sufficient volume for stability, glide and comfort. An extra 10 to 20 liters above the rider's weight is ideal for intermediate riders, while a board length between 5'7" and 7'0" ensures the right balance between maneuverability, control and progression. The Parawing Cloud One opens the door to the enjoyment of downwind riding and parawing by offering the same shape and design as the Cloud in a more accessible and forgiving version. It is the ideal parawing to start and progress, before moving on to the Parawing Cloud, designed for riders seeking maximum performance thanks to its Skytex canopy.

parawing-cloud.tagline: Performance, lightness and precision. Designed for demanding riders
parawing-cloud.presentation: Performance, lightness and precision. Designed for demanding riders, the Parawing Cloud combines lightness, precision and efficiency, while maintaining a healthy, stable behavior in all conditions. Its optimized profile delivers excellent performance and outstanding upwind ability, even in unstable or gusty winds. The depower is smooth and progressive, providing precise control and comfortable navigation. Balanced line lengths ensure natural handling and easy stowing on the water in a single movement. Paired with a full carbon bar that is both lightweight and ergonomic, the Cloud offers a direct feel, reduces rider fatigue, and enables smooth, efficient riding over long sessions. Built with simplicity and practicality in mind, it features color-coded bridles for easy untangling, a clear line color system, and lightweight yet durable materials. Available in 5 sizes, the Parawing Cloud allows for precise sizing based on rider weight and riding style, and is aimed at riders seeking performance, finesse and pure sensations.
parawing-cloud.cloud_vs_cloud_one: The main difference between the Parawing Cloud and the Cloud One lies in the choice of materials. The Cloud is built using Skytex fabrics, which are lighter and more technical, while the Cloud One features a 54 g/m² triple ripstop canopy. Thanks to its Skytex canopy, the Parawing Cloud offers a significant gain in lightness, responsiveness and overall performance, with a more efficient low-end range. Takeoffs are easier and handling feels sharper and more precise, especially in light wind and marginal conditions. Both the Cloud and the Cloud One share the same shape and design, ensuring a healthy, stable and perfectly balanced behavior on the water. They are also equipped with the same full carbon bar, providing a direct feel, precise control and excellent riding comfort. The Cloud One follows a more accessible and forgiving approach, with a deliberately reduced range of 3 sizes and robust materials focused on durability and value. It is an ideal entry point for discovering and progressing in parawing.

glide-air.tagline: Inflatable Wing Foil board with no compromise
glide-air.presentation: Discover the Glide Air, a wing foil board with no compromise! The Glide Air is the perfect board for beginners and advanced riders at a very affordable price. Easy to carry in a backpack, the Glide Air will allow you to travel lightweight and without any risk to your equipment while enjoying a board without compromising performance and comfort. The Glide Air's shape is based on our bestseller rigid board the Glide, fitted in an inflatable version. With its length and relatively flat rocker, the Glide Air offers an excellent glide allowing early take-off and good stability thanks to the generous width. The Glide Air is inflatable, sure, but also stiff! The reinforced drop-stitch combined with the pre-preg carbon plate on the hull provides a nice stiff feeling under the rider's feet for reactive riding. The Y-shaped foot strap will allow you to enjoy great freeride sessions. Perfect for beginners, the Glide Air is a high-performance inflatable board offering a wide range of use. It is also ideal for experienced riders looking for a board to ride while travelling. Besides being easy to carry and store, inflatable boards like the Glide Air have many advantages. They are lightweight, durable, and sturdy boards that withstand impacts and rarely get damaged. Riding on an inflatable board is safe. For beginners who experience frequent falls and shin splints, the contact with an inflatable board will be more cushioned and less traumatic. The Glide Air comes with a backpack that can hold its pump, which is also supplied. This dual-action inflation pump will allow you to inflate your board and kite effortlessly. And for those afraid of burning out on inflation before your session, don't worry: the 150L version of the Glide Air inflates to 17PSI in just 3 minutes!
glide-air.construction: The Glide Air benefits from the best inflatable board technologies. The board is made with reinforced woven dropstitch that ensures rigidity and shape retention. This technology, widely used in the recreational boating industry like inflatable stand-up paddles, offers a construction without compromise in terms of rigidity, durability, and performance. To improve the resistance, the rails are reinforced with a double layer of PVC. The inflatable part is completed with a pre-impregnated carbon plate where the foil attaches. This plate, located on the hull of the board and under the rider's feet, allows the foil to be fixed and reinforces the overall rigidity. Equipped with long Double Rails US Box for precise foil position adjustment.

glide-air-midlength.tagline: Incredible glide, versatile performance across all riding styles, and unbeatable portability
glide-air-midlength.presentation: The Glide Air Midlength is an inflatable wingfoil board designed for incredible glide, versatile performance across all riding styles, and unbeatable portability. With its refined shape and lightweight construction, it takes off effortlessly, accelerating smoothly and naturally. Whether in freeride, freefly, surf, or jump mode, it excels in all conditions—offering that extra touch of glide that makes all the difference. Its mid-length format strikes the perfect balance between downwind boards and compact shapes—not too long, not too short, just the right dimensions for maximum fun. Built with Woven Dropstitch Reinforced technology—the densest, highest-quality dropstitch on the market—it delivers a solid and durable foundation. Carbon stringers on the deck and hull, an exclusive innovation in the wingfoil market, further enhance its rigidity. This advanced construction ensures exceptional stiffness, already proven on our Escape Air, providing sharp, precise, and ultra-responsive glide sensations. With a 100% prepreg carbon plate for foil support, the Glide ML remains both durable and rigid while maintaining the accessibility of an inflatable board. This rigidity, combined with its shape, guarantees outstanding glide and exceptionally quick take-offs. Portable & Convenient: Ultra-light and easy to store, this inflatable board is effortless to transport. It also features an integrated carrying handle, allowing you to carry both the board and foil with one hand.
glide-air-midlength.shape: The shape and outline are inspired by SUP race boards: long, narrow, and voluminous, to offer a board with incomparable glide and a fast take-off. The pointed nose with a slight rocker gives the board excellent tolerance on touches and prevents nosedives. The pin tail provides speed and maneuverability thanks to reduced drag.
glide-air-midlength.construction: Reinforced woven dropstitch + carbon stringers on deck and hull (key role in board rigidity, take-off efficiency, effort transfer to foil). Double layer of PVC on rails. Pre-impregnated carbon plate on the hull for foil attachment with elongated Double Rails US Box (double opening for faster mounting).

foil-flow-aluminium.tagline: Ultra-versatile foil — exceptional glide, progressive lift, outstanding maneuverability
foil-flow-aluminium.presentation: The Flow is an ultra-versatile foil designed to combine exceptional glide, progressive lift, and outstanding maneuverability. Its profile has been engineered for very early takeoff, then effortless, sustained glide—perfect for linking bumps, extending downwind flights, or maintaining rhythm while pumping. Every acceleration feels smooth and efficient, every transition more fluid, and the sensation of glide lasts far beyond expectations. Built from pre-preg carbon, the Flow delivers ideal stiffness and an immediate, responsive feel underfoot. Its premium construction ensures precise handling while remaining forgiving and accessible, allowing riders to progress with confidence and ease. Available in six sizes—600, 700, 800, 900, 1050, and 1200 cm²—it covers a wide range of conditions and rider profiles. The smaller sizes offer a lively, playful character, ideal for powered surf or strong wind. The larger sizes stand out for their accessibility and endurance, making them perfect for light wind, advanced-level dock starts, or freeride and bump riding in wing and downwind conditions. We recommend pairing the Flow with the Glide HA stabs to unlock its full glide potential, or with the Carve stabs to emphasize maneuverability. The Flow Aluminium Foil comes equipped with the 17.5 mm Aluminium Mast, renowned for its exceptional stiffness and responsiveness, offering an excellent balance between performance and control. The Flow is mounted on our new V3 aluminium fuselage featuring a sacrificial anode for optimal durability, or on the V3 carbon fuselage for reduced weight and increased stiffness.
foil-flow-aluminium.flow_vs_flare: Flow: With its higher aspect ratio (around 10.7), the Flow delivers superior glide and longer-lasting lift. Less reactive in tight turns, it truly shines in small waves or light swell, where its ability to harness even minimal energy makes all the difference. In larger sizes, it is ideal for downwind or soft-swell surf, while smaller sizes remain versatile in more powerful conditions. However, when it comes to radical surf, the Flare retains the advantage. Flare: Featuring an intermediate aspect ratio of around 8.3, the Flare is built for aggressive surf riding. It turns extremely tight, reacts instantly underfoot, and still maintains strong glide and pumping efficiency. It excels in powerful waves, where sharp, radical maneuvers are the priority. In conclusion, the Flare prioritizes responsiveness and radical performance, while the Flow focuses on glide and endurance.

foil-flow-carbon.tagline: Flow versatility with carbon mast — sharper response, lower latency
foil-flow-carbon.presentation: The Flow is an ultra-versatile foil designed to combine incredible glide, progressive lift, and excellent maneuverability. Its profile has been engineered for very early takeoff, then effortless, sustained glide—ideal for linking bumps, extending downwind flights, or maintaining rhythm while pumping. Every acceleration feels smooth and efficient, every transition more fluid, and the sensation of glide lasts well beyond expectations. Built from pre-preg carbon, the Flow delivers perfect stiffness and a direct response underfoot. Its premium construction ensures precise handling while remaining forgiving and accessible, allowing riders to progress without constraint. You can choose between the HR and HM V2 masts in 16 mm, or the HM V2 mast in 13 mm. All are renowned for their very high stiffness and exceptional responsiveness, offering an ideal balance between performance and control. Available in six sizes—600, 700, 800, 900, 1050, and 1200 cm²—the Flow covers a wide range of conditions and rider profiles. The smaller sizes reveal a lively, playful character, perfect for committed surf or strong wind. The larger sizes stand out for their accessibility and endurance, making them ideal for light wind, advanced-level dock starts, or freeride sessions and bump riding in wing and downwind conditions. We recommend pairing the Flow with the Glide HA stabs to unlock its glide potential, or with the Carve stabs to enhance manoeuvrability. The Flow mounts on our new V3 aluminium fuselage, equipped with a sacrificial anode to ensure optimal durability of your foil, or on the V3 carbon fuselage for reduced weight and increased stiffness.

foil-flare-aluminium.tagline: Developed specifically for carving — most maneuverable foil in the range
foil-flare-aluminium.presentation: The Flare foil has been specially developed for carving. With this foil, the experience in turns is simply sensational and incredibly enjoyable. Transitions from one turn to the next are smooth and effortless. Designed for both wingfoiling and surf foiling, the Flare is our most maneuverable foil. It allows you to fully express your potential in the waves and during advanced freeride maneuvers. We recommend pairing the Flare with the Carve stabilizers. As a carving-focused foil, it is essential to unleash its full potential! Riders weighing over 80 kg can opt for the Carve 190, while lighter riders may prefer the Carve 160. The Flare mounts onto our new V3 fuselage, equipped with a sacrificial anode to ensure optimal durability for your foil.
